# Sign Transaction [signTransaction]

Signs a transaction. Alias of [`Actions.transaction.sign`](/docs/actions/wallet/transaction/sign).

## Usage

This example signs a transaction.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"989e3823f11973967786f7ca869b5607b7a1e10e78ad07ab5a87e4c6a39a3826","data":""}
import { client } from './viem.config'

const signed = await client.signTransaction({
  to: '0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8',
  value: 1n,
})
// @log: '0x02f86b0180843b9aca008502540be400825208...'
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"e723bd66cb15b4d7d69ea8d6648072af22227c65e3c112843c2aeafea47c6bfe","data":""}
import { Account, Client, http, walletActions } from 'viem'
import { mainnet } from 'viem/chains'

export const client = Client.create({
  account: Account.fromPrivateKey('0x…'),
  chain: mainnet,
  transport: http(),
}).extend(walletActions())
```

:::

### Standalone Action

Call `Actions.signTransaction` directly by passing the Client as the first argument.

:::code-group

```ts twoslash [example.ts]
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"3d9a710f2d281f2956e0ef06a1deb30d09c0d1f4a229726cdd1ed1c999daa7a5","data":""}
import { Actions } from 'viem'
import { client } from './viem.config'

const signed = await Actions.signTransaction(client, {
  to: '0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8',
  value: 1n,
})
// @log: '0x02f86b0180843b9aca008502540be400825208...'
```

```ts twoslash [viem.config.ts] filename="viem.config.ts"
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"83532250b55094da7908bd93a54fc62a7987056d7c2ad38670185c13a1307a7e","data":""}
import { Account, Client, http } from 'viem'
import { mainnet } from 'viem/chains'

export const client = Client.create({
  account: Account.fromPrivateKey('0x…'),
  chain: mainnet,
  transport: http(),
})
```

:::

## Return Value

`Hex`

The signed serialized transaction.

## Parameters

See [`Actions.transaction.sign`](/docs/actions/wallet/transaction/sign#parameters).

```ts twoslash
// @twoslash-cache: {"v":1,"hash":"1f5324952ca170c99fbe89f90a12f0d37cf7c468cdfce979026fd0751fdb2c5a","data":""}
import { Actions, Client, http } from 'viem'
import { mainnet } from 'viem/chains'

const client = Client.create({ chain: mainnet, transport: http() })
// ---cut---
const signed = await Actions.signTransaction(client, { // [!code focus]
  to: '0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8', // [!code focus]
  value: 1n, // [!code focus]
}) // [!code focus]
```
